title: Illustrative migration inventory
method: Fictional discovery exercise: 30 initial capabilities plus 10 previously omitted jobs = 40 obligations. Inventory grows by 10/30 ≈ 33.3%; effort and elapsed time are not assumed to grow in the same proportion.
alt: Illustrative migration inventory. User-facing capabilities: 30 capabilities; Scheduled jobs omitted: 10 capabilities. Illustrative inputs.
